definitions.explanation: A disease caused by pathogenic microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites that can spread from person to person or through other means of transmission.

examples.japanese: {感染症|かんせんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感染症|かんせんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful of the new infectious disease.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{感染症|かんせんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The government announced measures to prevent the spread of the infectious disease.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal medical and public health term frequently used in news reports and official announcements. Became especially prominent in everyday Japanese during the COVID-19 pandemic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感染症|かんせんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧ (disease prevention)
- {感染症|かんせんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧ (spread of disease)
- {感染症|かんせんしょう}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (disease countermeasures)
- {感染症|かんせんしょう}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (Infectious Disease Control Law)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伝染病|でんせんびょう}→伝染病：29731_densenbyou⟧: contagious disease (older term, still used)
- ⟦{疫病|えきびょう}→疫病：13609_ekibyou⟧: epidemic, plague (literary or historical)
